plan.summary: This 4-week block is the Building phase of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan. Week 1 establishes training maxes for the main percentage-based lifts so future loading is accurate, and the main training work starts in Week 2. The goal in this block is to raise the force ceiling with simple power work, solid main lifts, practical rows and trunk work, and only enough conditioning to support boxing without stealing recovery.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower- and upper-body strength with simple explosive work and controlled conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power with slightly heavier loading while keeping outputs sharp and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more of the power work toward faster and more boxing-relevant expression without forcing a speed peak.
